text: dsh-email-push-master 是一款面向 DSH Web 的邮件提醒插件，通过技能提供 notify 操作，并在设置页提供 SMTP 配置和连接验证。它让用户离开电脑时仍可收到目标完成、受阻、需要决策或长任务里程碑的邮件提示；设置页可填写 SMTP 服务器、端口、发件邮箱、授权码和收件邮箱，也能保存设置并验证 SMTP 登录。发送端使用 SMTP AUTH LOGIN 或 PLAIN 与所配服务器通信，支持发送文本邮件；QQ 与 163 邮箱可从发件地址推断服务器。需要可用的 SMTP 邮箱及授权码，配置保存在本机用户配置目录。

dsh-email-push-master sends SMTP email reminders for finished or blocked DSH goals, decision requests, and milestones. Its Settings page configures SMTP and checks authentication; its sender delivers plain-text email. It requires an SMTP mailbox and authorization code stored in local user config.
我离开电脑时，想让 DSH 在任务完成后发邮件提醒我。
DSH 任务卡住或受阻时，能不能通过邮件通知我？
I want an email when my DSH agent needs a decision while I am away.
dsh-email-push-master 的功能「设置 SMTP 邮件提醒」：设置页填写 SMTP 服务器、发件与收件邮箱和授权码，可保存配置并验证 SMTP 认证。
dsh-email-push-master 需要 SMTP 授权码；邮件通过用户配置的 SMTP 服务器发送，配置默认写入本机 ~/.config/dsh-email-push-master/config.json。

dsh-email-push-master README · dsh-email-push-master：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

**Email reminders from your DSH agent when you're away from the computer.**

You start a long-running goal in [DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) (or any AI coding agent), then walk away. When the agent finishes, gets blocked, or needs your decision, it sends an email to your phone mailbox — you see it and come back. One-way ping, no remote control.

dsh-email-push-master README · Origin & what changed：This is a fork of [dsh-notify-skill](https://github.com/PAKIKNOWLEDGE/dsh-notify-skill) (MIT, open source), hardened for stability:

- removed the `535` retry loop (it amplified account risk-control lockout) and fixed a `subject`/`text` crash;
- added connect/idle timeouts, a `--check` self-test, structured error classification, and full message headers.

See [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).

dsh-email-push-master README · Design: bundle a sender, avoid hand-written fallbacks：The skill ships **one zero-dependency implementation** — `sender.mjs` (only Node built-ins `tls`/`net`), so the agent sends mail deterministically in every normal DSH session (DSH runs on Node). The sender has connect/idle timeouts, structured error classification (`535`/`550`/network), **never retries `535`** (retries amplify risk-control lockout), and full message headers. The `SKILL.md` still carries the full contract:
section: Design: bundle a sender, avoid hand-written fallbacks

text:
dsh-email-push-master README · Design: bundle a sender, avoid hand-written fallbacks：- **when** to notify (goal done / blocked / before asking you a decision / long-task milestone),
- **what** to write (specific, in your language, short),
- the **config contract** (`config.json`: sender, SMTP authorization code, recipient; auto-inferred hosts for QQ/163 mail),
- how to **guide the user** through getting an SMTP authorization code when the config is missing,
- failure handling and security rules.
section: Design: bundle a sender, avoid hand-written fallbacks

text: dsh-email-push-master README · Design: bundle a sender, avoid hand-written fallbacks：If Node is genuinely unavailable (rare), the agent should stop and tell the user rather than hand-writing SMTP; hand-written SMTP is the main source of intermittent `535` auth failures.
section: Design: bundle a sender, avoid hand-written fallbacks

text:
dsh-email-push-master README · How it works：| Moment | Suggested marker |
|---|---|
| Goal completed | `done` |
| Goal blocked / stuck | `block` |
| About to ask the user a decision | `question` |
| Long task milestone | `info` |

The agent MUST send via the bundled sender (do not hand-write SMTP):

```bash
node sender.mjs "subject" "body"          # reads config.json next to it and sends
node sender.mjs --check                   # verify config + SMTP auth only, no email
```

dsh-email-push-master README · How it works：> Knowledge note (Windows): .NET `SmtpClient` has a known hang on implicit-TLS port 465 — the bundled sender uses `node:tls` instead, which has no such issue.

dsh-email-push-master README · Compatibility：| DSH version | Status |
|---|---|
| `0.2.0-rc.2` (current npm `latest`) | Supported — verified against the shipped runtime |
| `< 0.2.0-rc.2` (e.g. `0.1.2-rc.1`) | Not supported — 1.3.0 targets the current plugin APIs |
| `>= 0.3.0` | Not yet — update the plugin when DSH changes its plugin APIs |

dsh-email-push-master README · Compatibility：DSH refuses to install a plugin whose `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` **peerDependencies** do not satisfy the running
runtime, so an unsupported combination fails loudly at install time instead of crashing later:

```text
dsh: installation rejected: Plugin dsh-email-push-master@1.3.0 is incompatible with dsh 0.3.0: peerDependencies {...}
```

dsh-email-push-master README · Install (DSH)：**Plugin install (recommended)** — the skill ships as a DSH plugin and registers on `ctx.skills`:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-email-push-master
```

Or from GitHub: `dsh plugin --profile web add github:JamesYasR/dsh-email-push-master`. Restart `dsh web` once after installing, then the skill appears in the session skill catalog.

For the **desktop app**, either install into the `desktop` profile (quit the app completely first — it holds the
profile lock):

dsh-email-push-master README · Install (DSH)：```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-email-push-master
```

…or install into the `web` profile and use the browser GUI at the URL `dsh web` prints. Both share the same
web-based client UI, since the desktop shell serves the same web server.

**Manual install (no plugin)** — DSH also discovers skills from `<dshHome>/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` (default `~/.dsh/skills`), hot-reloaded by a filesystem watcher:

dsh-email-push-master README · Install (DSH)：```bash
git clone https://github.com/JamesYasR/dsh-email-push-master.git "$HOME/.dsh/skills/notify"
```

Or copy the folder manually to `~/.dsh/skills/notify/`. New sessions pick it up immediately.

dsh-email-push-master README · Setup (one-time, ~5 minutes)：1. Get an SMTP **authorization code** (not your login password):
   - **QQ Mail**: web QQ Mail → 设置 → 账户 → enable "POP3/SMTP 服务" → generate a 16-char 授权码
   - **163 Mail**: web 163 Mail → 设置 → POP3/SMTP/IMAP/SMTP → enable → create 授权码
2. Copy `config.example.json` to `config.json` and fill it in:
   ```json
   {
     "email": {
       "smtpHost": "",
       "smtpPort": 465,
   `smtpHost` may be left empty — it is inferred (`@qq.com` → `smtp.qq.com`, `@163.com` → `smtp.163.com`, port 465 SSL).
3. Test: ask your agent to send a test notification (it will use the bundled sender).

dsh-email-push-master README · Other agents (Claude Code, Codex, ...)：No compatibility work needed — modern agents are smart. Point them at `SKILL.md` and the config contract; they should use the bundled sender rather than re-implementing SMTP.

dsh-email-push-master README · Security：- `config.json` (contains your SMTP authorization code) and `notify.log` are **gitignored** — never force-commit them. A leaked authorization code lets anyone send mail as your mailbox.
- The skill instructs agents to never print or commit the authorization code.

dsh-email-push-master README · Quickstart：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:JamesYasR/dsh-email-push-master
```

Restart `dsh web`, then open **Settings → 邮件推送** (邮件推送 = “Email push”) to configure provider / server /
sender / auth code / recipient. Or run `node sender.mjs --check` for an auth self-test.

dsh-email-push-master README · Quickstart：The settings page is backed by the host's `/dsh-email-push/config` and `/dsh-email-push/test` routes; the SMTP
authorization code is never echoed back to the browser (masked echo + `hasAuthCode` flag — leave it blank to keep
the stored value).
